title: isolepis perpusilla

This plant is known for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of Isolepis perpusilla include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its therapeutic effects.
